reviews.review:
Very fun. The devs seem to care about their game which is rare now a days. Very fun and enjoyable, even in its current state.



EDIT: After a few years of playing this game I can say it still has held up to be a great game. Updates are keeping this game fresh and better then before. Amazing work Devs!
One of the best co-op games I've ever played. I can't recommend this game enough! Rock and stone!

"FOR KARL!" I got this game for free from one of my friends when it was my birthday, and from the moment i booted it up i was impressed. Let me make this clear THIS GAME IS EARLY ACCESS, you can tell that but the ideas are there, and they are very solid. I feel like the price might be a bit to high at the moment but the game is just so much fun especially with your buddies. After a long mining trip management will constantly pester you (in a funny way) to keep going mining, while you and your friends have a drink at the abyss bar in game drinking to another successful mission. The game has a perk system and weapon customisation that i feel need to be fleshed out a bit more but it works for now. The 4 classes are ballanced and all very useful to have. Only gripe i have with the game is the price $25 is quite a bit, and there is server issues, disconnects, crashing, glitching through walls, sometimes strange hitboxes etc. But of course early access is early access so those are forgiven. I hope that this game gets fleshed out more it really is a gem in the rot that has become 2018, hope more good games come out from this developer and many others in the future. ROCK AND STONE BROTHERS AND SISTERS!

*EDIT* 10/9/2019
update 25 has severely helped this games endgame content, and i applaud the devs for working so hard on what appears to be their dream game. Its hard to find game devs nowadays that are so passionate about their work, but you all at Ghost Ship games keep it up!
